column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_duel_eng.prx (runtime base 0x09be1400); same columns as re/documented.tsv.

column3: summary

Picks one of the four effect tables from the selector bits of ctx, binary-searches it on the card id, walks back to the first duplicate and adds the variant index; returns the 24-byte record or 0. No side effects.
Resolves an effect: calls the record's slot +04 handler with (ctx, arg); card 0x1975 is special-cased. Returns the handler's result or 0. Side effects: those of the handler.
Slot +04 handler shared by 44 cards: the controller draws duel_effects_get_draw_count(ctx) cards (a negative count or card 0x12da makes the opponent draw). Returns 0. Side effects: hand and deck.
Slot +0c handler shared by 17 cards: 0 when the draw count is 0, else duel_core_can_draw(controller, count). No side effects.
Per-card draw count: a compare chain on the card id (Pot of Greed 0x12ec gives 2), some counts computed from game state (e.g. 5 minus hand size), negative values mean the opponent. No side effects.
True when player (the opponent for a negative count) may draw |count| cards: no draw-preventing card (0x178b, 0x1885) applies and the deck holds at least |count| cards. No side effects.
Draws count cards for player via duel_core_draw_cards_ex(player, count, 1, 0); 47 callers. Side effects: hand and deck.

column2: int duel_effects_target_filter(void *ctx, int player, int index, uint flags)
column3: Returns whether field slot index (0-4 monster, 5-9 spell/trap, 10 field) of player passes the flags: side (bits 0-1), occupied/empty (0x4/0x8), slot +0x06 zero/non-zero (0x80/0x100), zone class (0x70) and further bits. Reached from 410 per-card stubs that load flags into a3 (bits decoded in effect-tables.md). No side effects.
Returns the current phase 0x09e2d1e8 (0 Draw, 1 Standby, 2 Main 1, 3 Battle, 4 Main 2, 5 End, 7 none). No side effects.
Returns 1 when the phase 0x09e2d1e8 is 2 (Main 1) or 4 (Main 2), else 0. No side effects.

Stores phase in 0x09e2d1e8 without animation and positions the turn step 0x09e2d210/sub-step 0x09e2d214 to match (phase 3 also sets the Battle step 0x09e2d220 to 1). Callers: the .ydq parser 0x09dc82cc and command 0x1a 0x09db3f40.

Body of engine commands 10-15. First call: UI event 5 (side, phase), stores the phase, runs the phase-change card hooks 0x09be6d90/0x09be71b4/0x09be6ac4; later calls: when the banner is done, 0x09be75f8, UI event 0x26 and the command completes (0x09e29904 = 0).

column2: int duel_core_post_ui_event(int event, int a, int b, int c)
column3: Stores the four arguments at 0x09e01e14..0x09e01e20 and calls the presentation hook at 0x09e01e10; returns 1. Over 100 callers (command handlers).
Returns duel_core_can_conduct_battle(side) when the phase is below 4 (not yet Main Phase 2), else 0. No side effects.
Activation condition: true when the turn side 0x09e2d1d8 differs from the owner bit of ctx+2 and the phase is 1 (Standby). No side effects; reached through the handler tables.

Returns the cached battle-dominance value of side (-4..4, from ai_eval_battle_dominance) at 0x09e28008 + side * 0x30c, or recomputes it when flag 0x09e03070 & 0x20 is set. No side effects. 129 callers.
Number of entries of one of the AI (card id, handler) priority tables; some lengths depend on state (0x09e03078, the battle dominance, the phase). No side effects.

column2: void * ai_table_entry(int side, void * table, int index)
column3: Returns entry index of an AI priority table, prepending the filtered opening table 0x09dfe500 to 0x09dfe848 and the chain table 0x09dfd448 to 0x09e00480; 0 for filtered entries. No side effects.

column2: int ai_pick_monster_by_stats(int side, uint slot_mask, int atk_sign, int def_sign)
column3: Shuffles the monster slots of side in slot_mask and returns the one with the highest (sign > 0) or lowest (sign < 0) ATK and/or DEF, +1 for monsters able to attack; -1 if none. Side effect: advances the duel RNG.

column2: int ai_pick_slot_by_score(int side, uint slot_mask, void * score_fn)
column3: Shuffles the slots 0-10 of side in slot_mask and returns the one with the highest positive score_fn(side, slot); -1 if none. Side effect: advances the duel RNG.

column2: void ai_push_context(int side, int view_side, int replan)
column3: Pushes (side, view, replan) on the AI context stack at 0x09e03028 (depth 0x09e03026), sets the AI side 0x09e02ff8 and view 0x09e02ffa, rebuilds the board view when they change and re-plans when replan is set. 28 callers (AI entry wrappers).
Linear congruential RNG: seed 0x09e2d1cc = seed * 0x343fd + 0x269ec3; returns n * ((seed & 0x7fffffff) >> 16) >> 15, in [0, n). Side effect: updates the seed. 100 callers.
AI table handler that always accepts (returns 1). No side effects; referenced only from the AI priority tables.
AI table handler that always refuses (returns 0). No side effects.

column2: int ai_chain_table_length(int side, void * table, int flag)
column3: Length of the chain-response AI tables: 345 for 0x09dfd448; 2 for 0x09dfdf10 and 181 for 0x09dfdf20 when flag != 0, else 0; 0 for any other table. No side effects.

Pays a Life Point cost: amount 0 is ignored, otherwise clamped to 0xffff and posted as engine command 0x24 (LP loss) with reason 2. No other side effects. 28 callers (Battle step 3 declaration costs, Standby/End Phase upkeep, effect handlers).
Life Point loss that is not a cost or damage (Jirai Gumo halves LP): posts command 0x24 with reason 3; amount 0 ignored, clamped to 0xffff. Callers: 0x09dd3574, 0x09c7c9a4.

column2: int duel_core_gain_lp(void *ctx, int player, int amount)
column3: Life Point gain from the effect context ctx. If the other side has Bad Reaction to Simochi or Nurse Reficule (and no Prime Material Dragon) the gain becomes damage via duel_core_inflict_damage and 0 is returned. Otherwise posts command 0x23 (reason 4), raises timing event 0x11 and checks Fire Princess; returns 1. Returns 0 for amount 0. 19 callers (effect handlers, duel_core_inflict_damage).

column2: int duel_core_inflict_damage(void *ctx, int player, int amount)
column3: Effect damage to player from the effect context ctx: applies Energy-Absorbing Monolith, Ring of Defense, Trap of Board Eraser, Barrel Behind the Door, Spell of Pain, Rainbow Life and Prime Material Dragon replacements and the prevention check 0x09c0d6ac, then posts command 0x24 (reason 0, source card), registers damage triggers and raises timing event 0x10. Returns 1 when damage was posted, else 0. 69 callers.

column2: void duel_core_inflict_card_damage(int player, int amount, int flip, int card)
column3: Builds a zeroed 24-byte effect context for card (controller bit = player ^ flip, presentation flags for non-monster cards) and calls duel_core_inflict_damage. 13 callers (Battle step 7, chain resolver, End Phase upkeep).

Applies one battle-damage record (amount, source side, source slot, damaged player, damaged slot): Power Wall reduction, command 0x24 reason 1 with the source monster's card id, trigger registration for 'when battle damage is inflicted' cards, timing event 0x0f. Returns nothing; amount 0 does nothing. Caller: Battle step 7 (0x09dd7528).

Handler of engine command 0x23; jumps to the shared body 0x09dbffd8 with a0 = 1: animates (UI events 0x10, 0x4d), then LP += a unless LP is 0, updates statistics, posts UI event 9 and finishes the command. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.

Handler of engine command 0x24; shared body 0x09dbffd8 with a0 = 0: LP = max(LP - a, 0); stores a special-victory card id in the winner's block +0x2c when a direct attack by such a card is lethal; statistics; UI events 0x10, 0x4d, 9. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.
Handler of engine command 0x25: UI event 0x0f, then sets the side's LP to argument a, statistics, UI event 9. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.

column2: void duel_core_battle_add_damage(unsigned int *src, unsigned int *dst, int amount)
column3: Writes the next free battle-damage record at 0x09e286e0 (amount, src side/slot, dst side/slot or the opponent and slot 5 when dst is NULL); flips the damaged player for Magical Reflect Slime, Amazoness Swords Woman, Metal Fiend Token and Dimension Wall. Caller: duel_core_battle_resolve.
Calls duel_core_battle_compute_stats(apply, 0). Callers: Battle steps 5 and 6, commands 0x15 and 0x16, 0x09cb8294.
Calls duel_core_battle_resolve(apply, 0). Callers: Battle step 6, commands 0x15 and 0x16, 0x09cb8294.
Stores the attacker's card instance and generation and those of the defender's five Monster Zones (12 words) into out. No other side effects. Caller: duel_core_cmd_declare_attack.

Returns how many of the opponent's five Monster Zones are valid targets for the monster at (side, slot) according to duel_core_is_valid_attack_target(mode 1). No side effects. Callers: Battle step 2, 0x09c63b2c.

Opens a timing-event batch: increments 0x09e28f90 and, at depth 0, clears the queue count 0x09e28f98 and the pending flag 0x09e29048 and increments the serial 0x09e28f94; in a link duel forwards it to the peer. About 200 callers.
Closes a timing-event batch (decrements 0x09e28f90; link duels forward it). About 200 callers.

Queues a timing event: outside a batch restarts the queue with it (code 0 just clears it), inside a batch appends it (max 32) at 0x09e28fa0/0x09e28fc0; sets the window-pending flag 0x09e29048 and resets the window state. Ignored while the chain resolves (0x09e28f9c); forwarded to the peer in link duels. 41 callers.

Response-window state machine run while 0x09e29048 is set: checks the end of the duel, skips the turn player when the first event is 0x17, 0x04 or 0x03, offers a window to the turn player then to the opponent (duel_core_offer_response_window); clears 0x09e29048 when a card was activated or both passed. Always returns 1. Callers: 0x09c32dac, 0x09c32e54.
Requests the processing of monsters destroyed by battle: 0x09e2d2bc = 4, 0x09e2d298 = 1, handled by the pending-work function 0x09c232bc. Caller: Battle step 9.
Handler of command 0x1d: Battle step index = 11, UI events 0x0e and 0x26, command finished. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.
Handler of command 0x14: Battle step index = 1, refreshes continuous effects (0x09be71b4), UI events 10 and 0x26, command finished. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.
Handler of command 0x20: sets flag bit 2 of slot a of the command's side and, when the battle record's destruction mode is positive, bit 6 of slot byte +0x36. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.

Returns the reason side has won (0 none, 1 opponent LP 0, 2 opponent +0x24 flag, 3 Exodia, 4 Destiny Board, 6 Last Turn, 7 Final Countdown, 8 special-victory card, 9 Vennominaga, 10 Exodius, 11 turn limit with fewer LP). Side effect: Last Turn sets 0x09e2d1d4. Caller: duel_core_check_duel_end.

Calls duel_core_check_win for both sides; when either won stores each reason in block +0x30, sets the result 0x09e2d1f0 (1 local, 2 opponent, 3 draw) and the latch 0x09e2d1d4, returns 1; otherwise 0. Skipped for the remote side of a link duel. Callers: duel_core_run_turn_flow, duel_core_chain_step, 0x09c2e244, duel_core_run_timing_windows.

column2: unsigned int duel_core_get_card_action_mask(int side, int location, int index)
column3: Returns the bit mask of player actions allowed for the card at (side, location, index) in the current input mode 0x09e2d24c; bit n = action code n. No side effects except the refusal reason in 0x09e2d288. No callers in the module (reached from rel_duel_draw).

column2: void duel_core_submit_player_action(int side, int location, int index, int code)
column3: Stores a player's answer (code 0x09e2d26c, side, location, index, card id and reference) and leaves input mode; in zone-selection mode only stores the zone in 0x09e2d284. Callers: AI main-phase code, duel_core_begin_player_input, the tutorial.

Pending-work function polled by duel_core_run_turn_flow: when an answer is ready, runs the action for code 0x09e2d26c (summon, set, flip, position change, activate, view list). Returns 1 while busy. Caller: duel_core_run_turn_flow.
Returns 1 when an answer is ready and its code is 0x0b (card or zone picked). No side effects. About 130 callers (selection loops).

column2: unsigned int duel_core_get_summon_set_mask_ex(int side, int ref, int mode, int tributes)
column3: Returns 0x10 if the hand card with reference ref may be Normal Summoned and 0x40 if it may be Set: card locks, LP costs, card-specific rules, then tributes = (level>=5)+(level>=7) against free zones and duel_core_count_tribute_value. Side effect: refusal reason 0x09e2d288. 24 callers (UI, AI, summon preparation).
True while bit 17 of player word +0x120 is clear, or while Double Summon or Chain Summoning still grants an extra Normal Summon. No side effects. 20 callers.
Sets bit 17 of player word +0x120 (Normal Summon used); if already set, marks the Double Summon or Chain Summoning entry as used. Callers: commands 0x50, 0x51, 0x2b.

Returns 1 if the monster in slot may change battle position: slot flag bit 21 clear (not arrived, attacked or changed this turn), no card lock, duel mode not 8. Side effect: refusal reason 3 or 0x12. Callers: action mask, flip check, AI.
Returns 1 if the face-down monster in slot may be Flip Summoned (position change allowed, flip summons allowed, card-specific conditions, summon locks). No side effects. 12 callers.

column2: int duel_core_begin_summon_from_hand(int mode, int special, int normal_flag)
column3: Starts a summon of the card in the current answer: calls duel_core_init_summon_from_hand(side, ref, special ? 2 : mode, normal_flag) and clears the answer. Returns 1. Callers: duel_core_execute_player_action, AI summon code, effects granting a summon.

column2: void duel_core_init_summon_from_hand(int side, int ref, int mode, int normal_flag)
column3: Fills the summon record 0x09e290bc for a summon from the hand (mode 1 Normal Summon, 0 Set, 2 Special Summon by procedure; normal_flag>=1 uses the Normal Summon, normal_flag-1 preselected tributes) and marks it pending. Caller: duel_core_begin_summon_from_hand.

column2: void duel_core_special_summon_impl(int side, void *entry, int face_up, int position, unsigned int flags)
column3: Fills the summon record for a Special Summon by an effect (kind 4) from the list entry or slot entry; Light of Intervention forces face-up; flags>>16 is the summoning card. Caller: duel_core_special_summon.

column2: void duel_core_special_summon(int side, void *entry, int face_up, int position, unsigned int flags)
column3: Wrapper of duel_core_special_summon_impl used by 67 effect handlers (Polymerization, revival effects, ...). Side effects: the summon record.

Pending-work state machine of the summon record: preparation (tributes or materials) through duel_core_summon_prepare, then the kind-specific executor (normal, flip, gemini, special, procedure). Returns 1 while busy. Caller: duel_core_run_turn_flow.

Generic tribute selection for the pending summon: computes the tributes needed, lets the player pick them (mode 8) or accepts the AI's choice, stores them in the record. Returns 1 done, 0 continue, -1 cancelled. Caller: duel_core_summon_prepare and card-specific preparations.

column2: int duel_core_change_position(int side, int slot, int flip, int a4, int by_effect, int a6)
column3: Changes a monster's battle position (and turns it face-up when flip): checks, posts command 0x33, marks bit 21 for a manual change, runs FLIP effects and raises timing event 9 or 0x0b. Returns 1 on success. 9 callers.

column2: void duel_core_place_spell_trap_from_hand(int side, int index, int zone, int face_up)
column3: Posts command 0x51 placing hand card index into spell/trap zone (face-up to activate, face-down to set) and raises timing event 0x0a when set. Callers: duel_core_action_place_spell_trap, 0x09c84fdc.

column2: void * duel_core_get_location_entry(int side, int location, int index)
column3: Returns the address of the 4-byte list entry (hand 0x0b, extra 0x0c, deck 0x0d, graveyard 0x0e, banished 0x0f) or the 20-byte field slot (location+index <= 10). No side effects. 40 callers.

Finds the card with instance reference ref on the field, in the graveyards, banished zones, decks, extra decks and hands; returns side | location<<8 | index<<16, or 0x1000. No side effects. 100 callers.

column2: void duel_core_zone_remove(int side, int location, int index)
column3: Removes a card from a list or field slot (per-list removers; for slots clears lingering effects and the slot). Callers: the movement command handlers.

column2: void duel_core_zone_insert(int side, int location, unsigned int pos, void *entry)
column3: Inserts a card entry into a list (deck top/bottom by pos) or a field slot (monster zones with position and face from pos). Callers: the movement command handlers.

column2: int duel_core_send_hand_card(int side, void *entry, unsigned int flags, int dest, int discard, int reason)
column3: Sends a hand card to the graveyard or banished zone (redirected by banish-instead rules) by posting command 0x3e/0x32/0x45; raises the matching timing event and per-card hooks. Returns the final destination. Callers: wrappers 0x09c18d70..0x09c18fe4.

column2: unsigned short duel_effects_get_fusion_material_code(unsigned int fusion_id, int slot)
column3: Returns the material code of slot 0-4 for a Fusion: hard-coded for 0x1e7e (5 slots) 0x1ab3 0x19ef (4) and 0x157e (code 1); otherwise a linear search of the 138-record recipe table at 0x09debe98 (u16 slot+1). 0 when unknown. No side effects. Callers: the fusion resolutions (0x09cbace0 0x09cbc3f4 0x09cbd3e4 0x09cbd838) contact fusion 0x09da868c and AI code (17 callers).

Number of materials: 5 for 0x1e7e and 0x157e; 4 for 0x1ab3 and 0x19ef; else 2 or 3 from the recipe table (3 when the third code is non-zero); 0 when the Fusion has no recipe. No side effects. 13 callers (contact fusion and AI).

column2: unsigned int duel_effects_card_matches_material_code(unsigned int code, int ref)
column3: Tests card reference ref against a recipe material code: codes 1-0x15 compare the monster Type (field slots 5-10 excluded); 0x16-0x1e call BOOT card-group lists; 0x1f Fiend of Level 6+; 0x20-0x23 a graveyard monster by Level band; larger codes are card ids matched through the alias table BOOT 0x0885fb5c (exact id for Neo-Spacian Fusion monsters). Chimeratech Fortress Dragon never matches. Reads effective id/Type/Level from the card's location. No side effects.

Synchro material admissibility before the Level test: own face-up monster in zones 0-4 not excluded and not already chosen; the first material must be a Tuner (duel_core_is_tuner_slot) with per-Synchro tuner ids (Turbo Warrior Junk Warrior Nitro Warrior Genex and Plaguespreader cases) and later ones non-Tuners with per-Synchro Type or Attribute restrictions. No side effects. Caller: duel_core_filter_synchro_material.

column2: unsigned int duel_core_filter_synchro_material(unsigned int side, int location, int index)
column3: Card-selection filter of the Synchro procedure: returns 0x800 when the slot is a candidate and duel_core_try_synchro_material proves that a complete material set can still be formed with its Level (card 0x1f32 may also count as Level 2). Callers: duel_core_summon_prepare_synchro (as callback) duel_core_try_synchro_material (recursion) and AI 0x09d22924.

column2: int duel_core_try_synchro_material(unsigned int side, int slot, int level)
column3: Backtracking step: rejects when level exceeds the Level still to cover (0x09e28f64); tentatively appends the slot to the material ring and subtracts; at 0 asks duel_core_synchro_materials_complete; otherwise succeeds if another zone 0-4 passes the filter. Restores the ring count and remaining Level before returning (no net side effects).

True when the chosen material count reaches the minimum 0x09e29058 and a monster zone will be free (a free zone or a material whose zone frees one). No side effects. Caller: duel_core_try_synchro_material.
Minimum number of Synchro materials: 3 for Mist Wurm (0x1d7d) and 0x1f25; 2 otherwise. No side effects. Caller: duel_core_summon_prepare_synchro.

column2: int duel_core_is_tuner_slot(unsigned int side, int slot)
column3: True when the monster in the slot is a Tuner: Lightwave Tuning (0x1e40) applied to it or a card of kind 31/33 (BOOT 0x088601c0: kind class 0x0f or 0x10). No side effects. Callers: duel_core_is_synchro_material_candidate 0x09c379ac 0x09c39760.

column2: void duel_core_set_slot_flag_bit(unsigned int side, int slot, unsigned int bit, int value)
column3: Sets (value != 0) or clears bit of the field-slot flag word at 0x09e2a56c + slot * 0x14 + side * 0xb3c. 24 callers (command handlers and the Synchro procedure, which records the 0x1f32 Level-2 choice in bit 7).

column2: int duel_core_card_has_attribute(unsigned int card_id, int attribute)
column3: card_db_get_attribute(card_id) == attribute. No side effects. Callers include the ritual table check (Earth Chant: 5 EARTH; Contract with the Abyss: 2 DARK).

Activation condition of the generic ritual record (S/T table record 2 used for every Ritual Spell without its own record): Special Summon allowed (0x09c0c458 too) and at least one ritual-table entry passes duel_effects_can_ritual_summon_entry. No side effects.

Ritual table entry index is usable by spell ctx: same spell id (or Earth Chant/Contract with the Abyss with an EARTH/DARK monster); the ritual monster is in the hand and summonable; and some tribute set exists (duel_effects_is_valid_ritual_tribute over own zones 0-4 and other hand monsters; with no free zone the first tribute must free one). Side effect: stores index in ctx+8 and resets the Level counters 0x09e28f64/0x09e28f68.

column2: int duel_effects_ritual_level_search(int *levels, int last, int need, int min_level)
column3: Recursive subset search over levels[0..last]: succeeds when some subset reaches need with an excess smaller than the smallest Level used (min_level carries it; start 0xff or 1 for exact-total spells). Pure function. Callers: itself and duel_effects_is_valid_ritual_tribute.

Resolution state machine of every Ritual Spell (state 0x09e28f60): pick the ritual monster (from the table entry or by selection for Machine Angel Ritual End of the World Earth Chant Contract with the Abyss); select tributes from hand and field until their Levels cover the table's Level total (Ritual Raven may cover it alone); tribute field monsters (0x09c26d50) and hand monsters (0x09c18e60); Special Summon the monster face-up (flags 1). Samsara (0x19da) on the field changes the tribute handling.

column2: void duel_core_compute_card_stats(int side, int slot, unsigned int *out, unsigned int flags, int timestamp)
column3: Fills the 13-word stat block of monster slot side/slot (name id, effective id, Type, Attribute, mask, Level, ATK, DEF, original ATK/DEF, immunity masks): original stats, the card's own continuous effect, other face-up cards and the field spell in timestamp order, attached records, equips, then Reverse Trap sign, Avatar/Cyber Blader/Water Dragon/Mirror Wall/Dreadroot, clamp at 0 unless flags bit 0. flags bit 1 ignores kind 1/2 records. No side effects. Callers: duel_core_get_card_stats, the ATK/DEF getters, duel_core_battle_compute_stats, the AI stat views.

column2: void duel_core_get_card_stats(int side, int slot, unsigned int *out)
column3: duel_core_compute_card_stats(side, slot, out, 0, 0). About 75 callers (effect handlers, AI, field send code).

column2: void duel_core_compute_base_stats(int side, int slot, unsigned int *out, unsigned int flags)
column3: Words 0/1 and 8-12 of the stat block: card-data ATK/DEF, name and effective id, immunity masks, trap-monster stats, the card's own original-stat rules and original-stat records (Unstable Evolution, Zero Sprite, Alchemy Cycle, ATK/DEF swaps). No side effects. Callers: compute_card_stats, the original-stat getters.

column2: void duel_core_get_base_stats(int side, int slot, unsigned int *out)
column3: duel_core_compute_base_stats(side, slot, out, 0).
Current ATK (stat-block word 6, clamped at 0). Callers: target rules, effect handlers, AI.
Current DEF (stat-block word 7, clamped at 0). Callers: effect handlers, AI.
Original ATK (word 8 of compute_base_stats). Callers: duel_core_battle_resolve, effect handlers, AI.
Original DEF (word 9 of compute_base_stats).

column2: int duel_effects_get_field_card_stat_bonus(unsigned int *stats, int src_side, int src_slot, int side, int slot, int *atk, int *def)
column3: ATK/DEF bonus that the face-up card at src_side/src_slot (monster or spell/trap zone) gives the monster described by stats at side/slot: chain on the source card id gated by the immunity words. Returns non-zero when either amount is non-zero. No side effects. Callers: compute_card_stats, 0x09c09e00.

column2: int duel_effects_get_field_spell_stat_bonus(unsigned int *stats, int src_side, int src_slot, int side, int slot, int *atk, int *def)
column3: Same for the field-spell zone card: Forest..Yami by Type, the Attribute fields, Neo Space, Necrovalley and others. No side effects. Callers: compute_card_stats, 0x09c09e00.

Writes Type, Attribute, Level, ATK and DEF of six trap/spell monsters (Cyber Shadow Gardna, Stronghold, Zoma, Metal Reflect Slime, Embodiment of Apophis, The Rival's Name) into a stat block. Callers: compute_base_stats, the race/attribute/level getters.

column2: int duel_core_attach_effect(int side, int slot, int kind, int key, int value)
column3: Takes the first free 10-byte record of the pool 0x09e2c7cc (1..255), appends it to the slot's list (slot +0x0a) with kind (bits 0-3, turn counter bits 4-7), key, value and timestamp 0x09e2d1d0. Returns the index or -1. Callers: command 0x35 and other command handlers, effect handlers, AI simulation.

column2: int duel_core_attach_instance_effect(int instance, int kind, int key, int value)
column3: Same as duel_core_attach_effect on the list of card instance `instance` (0x09e2bbcc + 6 * instance + 4). Callers: command 0x35 (instance form), 0x09d11480, 0x09dbe418, 0x09dbe814.
Clears pool record `index` and replaces it with its successor in every slot list and instance list that points to it. Callers: expiry, detach helpers, effect handlers.
Frees every record of a list. Callers: 0x09bef07c, duel_core_zone_remove.
Frees every kind >= 6 record on the field whose key is side | slot << 8 (the source card left). Caller: duel_core_zone_remove.

column2: int duel_core_slot_has_effect(int side, int slot, int key)
column3: 1 when the slot's list holds a kind <= 5 record with that key. No side effects. More than 250 callers.

Two targets: moves the equip card target 0 to monster target 1 when the new target is valid (duel_effects_can_equip_to, duel_core_move_equip_card).
*dst = *src.
Special Summons each target from its list (The Grave of Enkindling, The Shallow Grave face-down, Spear Cretin) with duel_core_special_summon_impl.
Returns every banished card of both sides to the Deck (duel_core_return_banished_card_to_deck) and shuffles; Necroface then gains 100 per card.
Raw target entry `index` of a link (first five in the link, the rest in the ring 0x09e28e50); Dark Deal shifts the index.
Number of Deck cards with that name.
Mask of the link targets still accepted by the record filter, destroyed in one batch (duel_core_request_send_mask, location 0x0e, flags 0x10000002).
Resolve handler: duel_effects_destroy_valid_targets, returns 0.
Special Summons the trap card itself as a monster (Defense Position for Cyber Shadow Gardna, Embodiment of Apophis, The Rival's Name).
When bit `bit` of 0x09e2bba0 differs, sets it locally and posts command 6 (bit, value); returns whether it changed.
Sets or clears bit `bit` of 0x09e2bba0.
Index of the first hand card with that name, -1 if none.
Number of slots of one side accepted by the record's slot +08 filter.
Card request mode 0x0c: negates every chain link below `index` that can be negated.
Activation step: opens the Deck list, sends the picked card to the Graveyard (duel_core_send_deck_ref_to_graveyard).
side | slot << 8 of the lowest set bit (slot + 16 x side), -1 for an empty mask.
Duel statistics: raises statistic `index` to `value` when larger (same storage as duel_core_add_statistic).
Arcana Force: tosses a coin (duel_core_request_coin_toss) and stores the result + 1 in the slot word.
Posts command 0x4f with the shuffle seed: the side's hand is shuffled unless it is public.

Slot 5-10 holding that name face-up, -1 if none.

column3: Number of enabled slots of the side accepted by pred.
Slots 0-10 of the side holding that name.

Number of hand cards whose card_db_get_race equals race.

column2: void duel_core_push_command(int op, int a, int b, int c)
column3: Appends (u16 op, a, b, c) to the engine command queue 0x09e29100 (8-byte entries) and increments the count 0x09e29900, unless the duel is a replay (0x09e02998 == 3) or the queue holds 256 entries. Bit 15 of op is the side, the low 12 bits the code. About 390 call sites in about 200 functions plus the thunk 0x09be14bc (effect handlers, summon/battle/phase steps, the tutorial).

Response-window state machine (state 0x09e29040) for side, answering link (or an open window when link is 0): CPU asks ai_chain_response / 0x09d9e108, human gets a prompt then duel_core_begin_player_input(side, link ? 5 : 4), remote sends net command 10; on a choice posts command 0x63 and performs the activation. Returns 1 when the window is closed (no response, or the activation done). Callers: duel_core_run_timing_windows, 0x09ccc634, duel_core_chain_build_step.

Opens player input. CPU side (0x09e02998[side] == 1): only mode 1, which submits the draw confirmation (submit_player_action(side, 0xd, 0, 0xc)). Otherwise clears 0x09e2d250/25c/258/260/28c, stores mode in 0x09e2d24c (1 Draw, 2 Main, 3 Battle, 4 open window, 5 response to a link) and side in 0x09e2d274. Callers: offer_response_window, step_draw_phase, step_main_phase, battle_step_select_attack.

Command 4 handler: toggles the turn side 0x09e2d1d8, increments the turn counter 0x09e2d1e0, phase 0x09e2d1e8 = 7, turn step/sub-step 0x09e2d210/214 = 0; card upkeep for 0x1dd9 and 0x1740; statistic 0x41; in tag mode tag_duel_swap_active_duelist(new side); UI event 6; finishes the command. Caller: duel_core_execute_command.

Tag duels: saves the side's hand, deck and Extra Deck lists (counts at player +0x0c/+0x10/+0x18, entries +0x124/+0x304/+0x4e4) as u16 card references, loads the partner's lists from the waiting area 0x09e02cc8 + side*300, stores the saved ones there, toggles 0x09e02cb8[side] and swaps the duelist kinds 0x09e02998[side] and 0x09e029a0[side]. Caller: duel_core_next_turn.

Tag-duel start: duel_core_reset, tag flag 0x09e2d1fc = 1, 0x09dc7dc4 (start set-up), then loads deck structures side+2 and 3-side (0x09e029ac + n*0xc0) for the first side 0x09e029a8 and the other. Returns 1. Caller: 0x09be154c.

True when hand card index of side is visible to the opponent: the whole hand is public (player word +0x120 bit 1) or the card's instance carries marker 0xfe0 or 0x1db9. No side effects. 9 callers, among them ai_analyze_board and duel_core_is_card_face_up_at.

Condition slot that always returns 0 (jr ra; move v0, zero): the record cannot be activated through the chain; the card is handled by engine code that tests its id. No side effects. Referenced only as a slot handler of 14 effect records.
Resolve slot that returns 0 and does nothing (jr ra; move v0, zero). No side effects. Referenced only as a slot handler (Royal Decree, Imperial Order, The Emperor's Holiday).

column2: void duel_core_send_ritual_hand_tribute(int side, int hand_index, int samsara)
column3: Sends a hand card Tributed for a Ritual Summon with duel_core_send_hand_card (reason 0x1000, destination 0x0e, or 0x0c/0x0d while 0x19da is active and samsara is set); a race-1 tribute adds player marker 0x14e2. Callers: duel_effects_resolve_ritual_summon (state 99) and 0x09da75f4.

For the side (xor 0x09e2d21c), changes to Defense Position every active, non-negated monster carrying marker 0x14d6 that is in its card list, posts marker 0x1419 for the position-locked ones and removes 0x14d6; returns 0 after one change, 1 when none is left. Caller: duel_core_battle_step_end.

1 when the card in (side, slot) has an active, non-negated effect and inflicts piercing damage: a card list equal to duel_core_has_piercing, plus Gadjiltron Dragon / Voltech Dragon by their tribute flag and the Familiar-Possessed by a slot marker. No side effects. Reached through the rel_duel_draw import stub 0x098ba474.

Posts engine command 0x2f with the card id: side < 0 gives b = 1 (both players), otherwise bit 15 marks side 1. 12 callers, among them duel_effects_resolve_ritual_summon and duel_core_battle_step_declare_attack.

column2: void duel_core_begin_select_tributes(int side, int a, int b, void *filter)
column3: Opens card-selection state 8 (0x09e2d24c = 8) with the validator duel_core_check_tribute_selection_soul_exchange and the arguments at 0x09e2d250..0x09e2d290; a CPU side answers at once through ai_run_card_selection, otherwise the result words 0x09e2d258/0x09e2d25c are cleared. 11 callers, among them duel_effects_resolve_ritual_summon.

Hand size limit of a side: 6; 0xffff (no limit) while Infinite Cards (0x1401) is active and newer than the opponent's Enervating Mist (0x1800); otherwise 5 when the opponent's Enervating Mist applies and 7 when Hieroglyph Lithograph (0x159f, effect value on slot 0x0b) applies, the newer one winning. No side effects. Callers duel_core_enforce_hand_limit and two CPU functions.

Number of Graveyard cards a Special Summon procedure banishes as its cost (1 for Spirit of Flames / The Rock Spirit / Spell Striker / Megarock Dragon minimum ..., 2 for Soul of Purity and Light / Fenrir / Earth Giant Gaia Plate ..., 3 or 7 for others; 0x1c2a/0x1c2b/0x1bc8/0x1bc9 depend on the choice byte 0x09e290f4); 0 when the card has no such procedure. No side effects. Callers duel_core_summon_step_banish_procedure and 0x09daaad8.

1 when the die result negates for this Archfiend: 3 for 0x168c/0x168d/0x168f, 1/3/6 for 0x168e/0x1692 (mask 0x25), 2/5 for 0x1690/0x1691; 0 for other cards. No side effects. Callers duel_core_chain_step and duel_core_action_dice_roll.

column2: int duel_core_filter_moth_procedure_material(int side, int slot, int offset)
column3: Material filter of the Moth procedures: 0x800 when field slot slot+offset holds Petit Moth (0x10bc) that the summoning side may Tribute, a monster zone is or becomes free, and a non-negated Cocoon of Evolution (0xfee) link on it has a turn count of at least 2 (Larvae Moth), 4 (Great Moth) or 6 (Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth) for the card being summoned (0x09e290c0); else 0. No side effects. Caller 0x09d9fce4 (under duel_core_get_special_summon_mask) and duel_core_get_procedure_material_rule.

column2: int duel_core_filter_familiar_possessed_material(int side, int slot, int offset)
column3: Material filter of the Familiar-Possessed procedures: 0x800 when slot slot+offset of the summoning side holds the Charmer that belongs to the card being summoned (Aussa/Eria/Hiita/Wynn) and another monster of the summoned card's Attribute can be sent (or, in the second step, when the slot is a monster of that Attribute other than the chosen Charmer), with a free or freed monster zone; else 0. No side effects. Caller duel_core_get_special_summon_mask.

column2: int duel_core_filter_procedure_material(int side, int slot, int offset)
column3: Material filter of the one-monster Special Summon procedures: for the card being summoned (0x09e290c0) tests the monster in slot slot+offset (Zoa with Metalmorph for Metalzoa, Red-Eyes B. Dragon with Metalmorph for Red-Eyes Black Metal Dragon, a Level 7+ monster for Plasma Warrior Eitom, Grand Tiki Elder or Melchid for Masked Beast Des Guardius, same-name tests for the Dark Magician / Red-Eyes / Blue-Eyes upgrades ...); 0x800 when it is a valid Tribute of the summoning side, else 0. No side effects. Callers 0x09d9fe24, 0x09da4314, 0x09da446c.

column2: void duel_core_add_active_card_count(int side, int card_id, int amount)
column3: Adds amount to the slot value (+0x40) of every active, non-negated copy of card_id on side (monster zones for a monster id, Spell/Trap zones otherwise). The card-move commands use it to count events for Fatal Abacus (0x14bf), Skull Invitation (0x1361) and 0x16da. Callers duel_core_cmd_move_list_card, _cmd_send_field_card, _cmd_destroy_by_battle, _cmd_tribute_card, _cmd_banish_field_card, _cmd_destroy_by_effect.
Sets bit 7 of the slot flags (+0x44) of every active, non-negated copy of card_id on side; same slot scan as duel_core_add_active_card_count. Callers: the card-move commands (0x1762, 0x1574 ...).

For every copy of Fatal Abacus (500) or Skull Invitation (300) with a non-zero counter: clears the counter and, if the card is active, inflicts the per-card amount times the count byte of each player to that player; returns 1 when damage was dealt. Function pointer only.

For every Spell/Trap copy of card_id with a non-zero counter: clears it and, if active, inflicts 500 times the counter to the opponent (source 0x1306, Magical Thorn); returns 1 when damage was dealt. Function pointer only.
1 unless Deck Lockdown (0x1dd1) is active. No side effects. Callers duel_effects_collect_deck_candidates and two CPU functions.
Condition handler of Time Stream: the acting side can Special Summon and Non-Fusion Area (0x197a) is not active. No side effects. Function pointer only.

Candidate filter of Instant Fusion: rejects while Non-Fusion Area (0x197a) is active or the candidate carries the side marker of its own id (except kind 0x24); otherwise duel_effects_can_special_summon_candidate. Function pointer only.
Smallest effect value (0..0xffff) of the Zone Eater (0x112f) and Steel Scorpion (0x1130) markers on the slot, 0x10000 masked to 0 when none. No side effects. Function pointer only.

1 when effect damage to side becomes LP gain: the side has the Rainbow Life marker (0x1d27) and its LP gain is not reversed, or Prime Material Dragon (0x1d8f) is active and the opponent controls neither Bad Reaction to Simochi (0x1256) nor Nurse Reficule the Fallen One (0x1cb8). No side effects. 7 callers (damage posting and CPU estimates).

End Phase step: returns 1 at once while Spiritual Energy Settle Machine (0x150e) is active; otherwise queues field trigger 5 (return to hand) for every face-up Spirit monster summoned or flipped this turn, made optional (argument 1) by Izanagi (0x1dfc) on its side or a Mirror of Yata (0x1e02) link; returns 0 after the first queued trigger when a chain is pending. Function pointer only.

Determines the active Field Spell: the face-up, unnegated card in slot 10 of either side, else Umi (0x10f4) while Maiden of the Aqua (0x13a2) is face-up; posts duel_core_post_field_spell_change when it differs from 0x09e2bbc8 and returns 1 then. Caller duel_effects_check_rule_list.

1 when control of the monster cannot change: slot flags 3/4, card_db_is_control_locked, or Element Valkyrie / Element Soldier / 0x1826 while a face-up WATER monster is on either field; 0 when its effect is inactive. No side effects. Callers duel_effects_can_take_control and 0x09c146f0.

After an attack: sets the attacked bits (0x200000 and bit 22/23) of the slot, attaches the attack-count effect for the multi-attack monsters (0x1b20 kind 2; Chimeratech Overdragon, Chain Thrasher, 0x18a6, Armed Samurai - Ben Kei kind 1) and a side marker when Cyber Dragon, Red-Eyes B. Dragon or 0xfa6/0xfa7 attacked. Callers duel_core_cmd_attack_done, duel_core_cmd_negate_attack, 0x09db3f40.

column2: int duel_core_substitute_covers_slot(int side, int slot, int substitute_id)
column3: 1 when the monster in the slot is protected by the destruction substitute substitute_id: same name as 0x1e7f for 0x1f0d, Plant Type (13) for Nettles (0x1df3), a Six Samurai otherwise. No side effects. Callers duel_core_battle_step_damage_calc, duel_core_send_batch_step.

column2: int duel_core_is_destruction_substitute(int side, int slot, int battle)
column3: 1 when the slot's card can be destroyed instead of a protected monster: a card of the BOOT list 0x08861d2c, 0x1f0d, or Nettles (in battle only when it is not the attack target of the current battle). No side effects. Same callers as duel_core_substitute_covers_slot.

Target filter of Time Stream: a Fusion monster passing flags 0x15 whose name is Cenozoic Fossil Knight - Skullger (next 0xea2) or Mesozoic Fossil Knight - Skullknight (next 0x1c55), when the next form is in the Extra Deck and can be summoned, with a free or freed monster zone. No side effects. Function pointer only.

column2: int duel_effects_filter_target_by_source(void *ctx, int side, int slot)
column3: Shared target filter: duel_effects_target_filter with flags 0xc15, then a condition chosen by the source card id (*ctx): Tail Swipe (Level 5+ Dragon), The League of Uniform Nomenclature, Lone Wolf (Monk Fighter / Master Monk / Chu-Ske), Ninjitsu Art of Decoy (Ninja), Battle-Scarred (Archfiend), Staunch Defender (not Guardian Kay'est, not The Legendary Fisherman with Umi), Machine Duplication, Defense Maiden (Maiden in Love), Jam Defender (Revival Jam). No side effects. Used by six effect records.

Whether the active negation locks (duel_effects_collect_negation_state) negate card_id for side: Traps under lock state 2 except Royal Decree (0x1302) or state 1, Spell icons 2/3/4 and monsters under their locks; cards of the BOOT list 0x088669e4 are exempt. No side effects. Caller duel_effects_is_negated_on_resolution.

Damage calculation on the two battle records (attacker 0x09e28650 + attacker x 0x48): compares ATK with ATK or DEF, sets the destroyed flags (+0x34) and calls duel_core_battle_add_damage (piercing through duel_core_has_piercing or the piercing equips); then duel_core_battle_is_destroyed, duel_core_get_battle_destroyed_negation (+0x40), Gravekeeper's Vassal / Rainbow Life player markers, duel_core_battle_is_damage_prevented, the double (Stone Statue of the Aztecs, Canyon, Cross Counter, Piranha Army on a direct attack) / halve (Shadowknight Archfiend, Susa Soldier, Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins, Arcana Force XIV) / fixed (Rod of the Mind's Eye 1000, Dark Scorpion Combination 400, Submarineroid original ATK) / zero (Clear Wall at 1000 or less) rules, and the after-battle markers of the battling monsters (Maiden in Love counter, The Unhappy Girl lock, Ally Bomb, Gonogo, Ryu Kokki, Getsu Fuhma, Kaminote Blow, Sword of Dragon's Soul). apply = 0 posts nothing; simulate keeps damage an effect would take over. Amounts clamped to 0xffff. Callers: duel_core_battle_resolve_live, AI 0x09d06188 / 0x09d30ef0.

For the monster destroyed by battle (the defender when defender_destroyed, else the attacker): 0 when it is not an effect monster; 1 (or 2) when the destroyer negates its effects: Element Doom / Element Saurus / Element Soldier with a DARK monster face-up, Dark Lucius LV4/LV6/LV8, Ancient Gear Beast, Terrorking Archfiend, Guardian Baou, Ultimate Obedient Fiend, Dark Balter the Terrible, Flip monsters only for Twin-Headed Wolf (another Fiend), Blade Knight (alone) and Harpie Lady 2; Diffusion Wave-Motion marker, Wicked-Breaking Flamberge - Baou link, Dark Ruler Ha Des (Fiend destroyer) and Revived King Ha Des (Zombie destroyer) give 1, or 2 when another copy than the destroyer applies; marker 0x1f19 gives 2. With apply posts the Element Soldier / Dark Lucius LV6 / Diffusion Wave-Motion markers. Result stored in battle record +0x40; command 0x20 sets slot byte +0x36 bit 6 from it. Caller: duel_core_battle_resolve.

Battle step 4. Sub-step 0 snapshots the attacker and the five defender instances (0x09e28730...); 1 posts The Dark Door's player marker; 2 applies forced negations (Mirror Wall marker kind 7 on the attacker, Hero Barrier with an Elemental Hero, Necro Gardna, Cyber Barrier Dragon in Attack Position) and posts command 0x1f when one applied; 3 (first declaration only) duel flag 1, the Ancient Gear player marker 0x18ab on the opponent (Spell/Trap lock until the end of the Damage Step), White Veil markers, duel_core_mark_battle_opponent_negated for Advanced Dark and Rainbow Veil, statistic 0x10, Super Vehicroid - Stealth Union marker, duel_core_raise_attack_event; 4 raises timing event 0x13 while events were queued. Replay check in 3 and 4. Returns 1 when the step is finished. Caller: duel_core_run_battle_steps (table 0x09e01dcc).

Battle step 7. Sub-step 0 raises timing event 0x0e for each non-zero damage record (outside an effect battle); sub-step 2: queues the attacker's 'inflicts battle damage' trigger (event 0x1e2: Red Dragon Archfiend, Nitro Warrior, Alien Hunter, Ruin, Divine Dragon - Excelion, the Element monsters, Black Luster Soldier - Envoy, Rocket Warrior, 0x1f19) or removes the Satellite Cannon / Satellite Laser marker, then duel_core_apply_battle_damage for both records, Gravekeeper's Vassal effect damage (duel_core_inflict_card_damage), Rainbow Life gain (duel_core_gain_lp), Reflect Bounder destroys the attacker, Cloudian monsters / Berserk Gorilla / Scab Scar Knight attacked in Defense Position are destroyed. Returns 1 after sub-step 2. Caller: duel_core_run_battle_steps.

Battle step 8 (not for direct attacks). Sub-step 0: Kotodama (duel_effects_apply_unique_name_rule), Spirit Reaper (duel_core_destroy_targeted_spirit_reapers), a 6000-ATK trigger; sub-step 1: queues 'after damage calculation' triggers (event 0x2a2) of both monsters by card (Ally of Justice - Unknown Crusher vs LIGHT, D.D. Assailant, D.D. Warrior Lady, Divine Knight Ishzark, D.D. Crazy Beast, Mechanical Spider, Kangaroo Champ, D.D. Warrior, Kelbek, Wall of Illusion), marks the monster battled by Swordsman from a Foreign Land / Zone Eater (command 0x46, 5 turns), Steel Scorpion (3 turns) and Electric Lizard (marker kind 0x21), the Advanced Dark family follow-up (0x09e28648) and Cloak and Dagger. Returns 1 when finished. Caller: duel_core_run_battle_steps.

During the Damage Step steps 4-6 of a monster attack: for each active copy of card_id (Rainbow Veil: the equipped monster battles an opponent's monster; Advanced Dark: a Rainbow Dragon battles) marks the opposing face-up monster with a kind-9 marker naming the card, unless it is already linked from it. Returns 1 when a marker was posted. Caller: duel_core_battle_step_attack_declared.

Rule check: destroys the first active monster in Defense Position (slot +0x3a) that the rule may destroy (duel_effects_can_card_destroy_slot) among the Cloudian monsters, Berserk Gorilla and Scab Scar Knight; returns 1 when it requested a destruction. Called through a rule-function pointer.

End-of-duel bonus table: 82-case jump table at 0x09deb640 (one case per bonus index 0-0x51) writes the points of each bonus to the result block +0xc4 + 4 x index (character flags, duelist level, LP thresholds 100 / 1000 / 20000 and exactly 5730, deck size, statistics through 0x09dcb734, 'card X was used' through duel_core_was_card_used_in_duel, finishing card Skull Servant) and 30 x the number of awarded bonuses to +0x20c. Caller: duel_core_record_duel_result. Body repaired with tools/ghidra/FixJumpTableFunction.java.

Unique-name rule of an active card_id (Kotodama): every face-up monster not yet linked from it is either linked (kind-9 marker) or, when 0x09bfd0b4 reports a duplicate name and the card may destroy it, added to a destroy mask posted with duel_core_request_destroy_mask_by_card. Returns 1 when it posted. Caller: duel_core_battle_step_after_damage_calc.

1 when the battle record's monster is not an effect monster, or its destruction mode (+0x40) is 0 and its effect is active. Callers: duel_core_battle_step_inflict_damage, duel_core_battle_step_after_damage_calc.

Prompt-request kind 4 (state 0x09e2d2d0): asks with Great Shogun Shien's name (message 0x14d) whether to destroy another monster instead, then opens a card selection (filter 0x09c13cf0) and stores the pick in 0x09e2d2d8 / 0x09e2d2da. Returns 1 when done. Called through the prompt dispatcher.

column2: int duel_core_prompt_advanced_dark_deck_card(int side, int card_id, int arg)
column3: Prompt-request kind 8: for Advanced Dark shows hint 0x121 and opens the Deck list (location 6); stores the picked card id and instance in 0x09e2d2d8 / 0x09e2d2da. Returns 1 when done. Called through the prompt dispatcher (battle step 6 sub-step 0x73).

Target filter of Flipping the Table: duel_effects_target_filter with flags 0x21071 (own side) or 0x1802 (opponent's), rejecting monster slots with an active Dizzy Angel. No side effects. Caller: effect record M3 34.

Resolve of Physical Double: step 0x80 Special Summons a Mirage Token in the target's image unless no zone is free, Special Summons are blocked, the token's Attribute or Type may not be summoned, or Power Filter is active and the copied ATK is 1000 or less; step 0x7f stores the copied Level/Attribute, ATK and DEF as three kind-5 markers on the token. Returns 0x7f after the summon, else 0.

Number of distinct card names of the given Attribute in the side's Graveyard plus the alias-name bits (duel_core_get_alias_name_bits); The Lady in Wight counts as Skull Servant and Harpie Queen as Harpie Lady. Callers: duel_core_get_summon_set_mask_ex, duel_core_get_special_summon_mask, 2 AI functions.

Unless Royal Command or Fiend Skull Dragon is active: finds the first monster (side first) carrying marker key, removes the marker and requests sending it (location 0x0e, flags 0x10002) by card key; returns 0 then, 1 when nothing was done. Called through a pending-work pointer.

Candidate-filter callback of a pending selection prompt by card id (Creature Seizure, Rare Value, Inferno Reckless Summon, Spatial Collapse, Armor Exe: slots with Spell Counters, Pineapple Blast, Dark Coffin family, Bubble Crash, Dummy Golem / Creature Swap, Patrician of Darkness, Ectoplasmer, Arcana Force VIII); 0 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: duel_core_pending_select_with_hint, ai_choose_hand_card_by_card.

Destroys the first active Spirit Reaper / Reaper on the Nightmare that carries a targeting marker (duel_core_find_slot_marker with 0x09cdfbac) and removes that marker; returns 1 when it requested a destruction. Caller: duel_core_battle_step_after_damage_calc.

Activation step (slot +10) of 13 M3 records: a compare chain on the card id selects the number of cards to discard (1 to 5; Final Destiny 5, Spell Vanishing 2, Lightning Vortex 1) and calls duel_core_request_discard_cost(side, n, 0, 0); one path adds a marker through duel_core_post_add_marker. Every case returns 1 (continue). Callers: the slot +10 pointer of its records (no direct jal).

Activation step (slot +10) of one M3 record (0x1c53): the same discard-count chain as duel_effects_cost_discard_b, plus an LP payment (duel_effects_get_lp_cost, then duel_core_pay_lp). Every case returns 1. Callers: the slot +10 pointer of its record.

Activation step (slot +10) of 13 S/T and 11 M3 records, also called by 0x09c47e84: per-card costs chosen by the card id: pay LP (duel_core_pay_lp; 800 for Royal Oppression), send the top cards of the Deck (duel_core_mill_deck_as_cost; 2 for Lightsworn Barrier), discard, banish from the Graveyard, send a field card, ask yes/no (message 47). 125 of 130 cases return 1 (continue).

Activation step (slot +10) of 21 M1 and 17 M2 records: per-card costs and checks chosen by the card id: a discard-count chain (a1 = 1, 2 or 5) into duel_core_request_discard_cost, LP costs (duel_effects_get_lp_cost), Tributes, counters; a case whose check fails (no valid target, cost not payable) returns -1 (cancel). Returns the value kept in s3. Callers: the slot +10 pointer of its records.

Target filter (slot +08) of 6 S/T and 2 M1 records: after duel_effects_target_filter, a predicate chosen by the source card id: Plant-Type (Type 13; Fragrance Storm), at least one counter 0x0f (Detonator Circle A), at least four counters 0x12 (Diamond-Dust Cyclone), a linked Flint 0x1842 (Flint Missile), a Ritual or Fusion monster (Ritual Sealing, Anti-Fusion Device). Returns the predicate. No side effects. Callers: slot +08 of its records and 0x09d57c6c.

Target filter (slot +08) of 38 records (S/T 27, M3 5, M1 4, M2 2): a predicate on the slot's monster chosen by the source card id: Machine-Type (Type 7), Fiend-Type (Type 3), Level 8, a named card (duel_core_is_slot_card_named), Iron Chain monsters, not a token. Returns 0 or the predicate. No side effects. Callers: slot +08 of its records, 0x09c3acc8 and 0x09c3fd74.

column2: int ai_estimate_card_atk(int side, int location, uint card, uint mode)
column3: ATK the AI expects card to have. A field slot (location 0-10) returns duel_core_get_atk(side, location). For location -1 (hypothetical) or a list (0x0b-0x0f) it starts from the printed ATK (card_db_get_atk); mode >= 2 returns that; mode 0/1 adds about 100 per-card compare-chain cases (archetype and Graveyard counts, the LP difference, +10000 / +100000 markers for cards the AI must value highly, some cases only for mode 0 or not in the banished zone), then -300 per copy of 0x1483 and -100 x Level per copy of 0x1ce7 on the opposing side, then a field-spell bonus by Type/Attribute (+-200 for 0x10f0-0x10f5 and about 20 other field cards, from the field card id at 0x09e2bbc8), clamped at 0. No side effects (stack buffers only). 33 callers (target, cost and candidate choosers, ai_reject_candidate, ai_rate_slot_threat) plus ai_estimate_off_field_atk.

ai_estimate_card_atk(side, -1, card, 1): expected ATK of a card that is not on the field. Pure. 45 callers (ai_handler_revive_monster, ai_handler_ritual_summon, the candidate and hand choosers, ai_eval_attack).

Index of the first entry of the current candidate list (duel_core_get_candidate_count / duel_core_get_candidate_entry) whose card id (low 14 bits) is card, that is not selected yet (duel_core_get_candidate_selection <= 0) and that ai_reject_candidate(top card of the AI candidate stack, index) keeps; -1 if none. Pure. Caller 0x09d440d8 (candidate chooser of kinds 6 and 0x4a, whose compare chain asks for specific cards).

column2: int ai_board_add_interest_record(int side, void *record, int weight)
column3: Adds a 24-byte record to side's table of 32 records at 0x09e28014 + side * 0x30c (inside the board-view block of ai_analyze_board): if a record with equal words +4..+0x14 exists, adds weight to its u16 +0 and returns 0; otherwise copies the record into the first free entry (u16 +0 == 0), sets u16 +0 = weight and returns 1; returns 0 when all 32 are used. Callers ai_board_note_card_interests, ai_board_note_combo_interests, ai_analyze_board.
Highest ai_get_visible_battle_stat over side's occupied monster zones 0-4; 0 when there is none. Pure. 15 callers (ai_choose_slot_by_card, ai_handler_on_attack_declared_event, per-card handlers).

column2: int ai_find_best_monster_slot(int side, uint exclude_mask, int use_atk, int use_def)
column3: Monster zone 0-4 of side (bits of exclude_mask skipped) with the highest value: ATK clamped at 0 when use_atk, raised to DEF when use_def and DEF is larger. Real stats (duel_core_get_card_stats with the card made face-up for the call) on the AI side 0x09e02ff8, the estimate 0x09ce9edc on the other side. -1 when none. No lasting side effects. 7 callers (ai_get_best_monster_value, 0x09d9c2c4, 0x09d9d238, per-card handlers).

column2: int ai_get_best_monster_value(int side, uint exclude_mask, int use_atk, int use_def)
column3: The value (same rules) of ai_find_best_monster_slot's monster, -1 when none. No lasting side effects. 26 callers (ai_choose_target_by_card, ai_decide_optional_activation, per-card handlers).

duel_core_get_hand_size_limit(side); unless that is 0xffff (no limit), plus min(copies of card 0x1d25 active on side, free monster zones). Pure. 11 callers (ai_can_afford_draw, main-phase helpers, per-card draw handlers).
duel_core_can_enter_battle_phase(controller of ctx, i.e. byte +2 bit 0 xor byte +3 bit 6). Pure. 10 callers.

Criteria by which battle plan a beats plan b, as a bit mask that the caller ANDs with the criteria it cares about (any set bit = keep a). 0 at once when a.own_lp (+0x10) <= 0 and b.opp_lp (+0x14) > 0, or a.own_deck (+0x1c) <= 0 and b.opp_deck (+0x1e) > 0. Otherwise 0x10 when (a.opp_lp <= 0 and b.own_lp > 0) or (a.opp_deck <= 0 and b.own_deck > 0); 0x08 when a.opp_monsters (+6) < b.opp_monsters; 0x04 when a.opp_lp < b.opp_lp; 0x02 when a +0x0c > b +0x0c. Pure. 19 callers (ai_plan_battle_with_tricks with masks 0x1e / 0x10, ai_handler_boost_if_plan_improves, union and revive handlers).

column2: void ai_plan_init(int side, int full, void *from_plan, int arg)
column3: Resets the working plan 0x09e276e4 for side: LP +0x10 (side) / +0x14 (opponent) and deck counts +0x1c / +0x1e from the player blocks, or taken crosswise from from_plan (the other side's plan) when it is given; destroyed and damage counters +0x00..+0x0c zeroed; +0x18 dominance from the board view; +0x20 = arg; the five per-monster attack entries cleared (target 5 = none, +0x0c set when the monster is in Defense Position or 0x09d3996c says it cannot attack) and the four 32-byte attack records at 0x09e277a8. full != 0 sets 0x09e27ff2. Callers ai_build_battle_plan, ai_simulate_attack, 0x09d177e0, 0x09d0f634.
Address of entry index (4 bytes, card id in the low 14 bits of u16 +0) of the candidate list at 0x09e29928. Pure. Callers ai_find_candidate_index_by_card and the selection code.
Number of entries in the current candidate list (0x09e29920). Pure.
High byte of the u16 state of candidate index (0x09e2a128 + 2 * index); non-zero once the candidate is selected. Pure.

Condition slot of The Sky Lord's S/T record 4 and its two siblings: 1 when the controller's Graveyard list (+0x55c, count +0x53c) holds an Arcana Force monster of the Level range of the card (0xe94: 5-6, 0xe93: 1-4, 0xe92: 7 or more). Pure.

Target-choice slot (Declaration of Rebirth, DNA Surgery, The Regulation of Tribe): state 0 asks the Type (duel_core_request_declare_type), state 1 stores it as the slot value and records it in the link (command 0x28 past 5 entries), state 2 posts command 8. Returns 0 while working, 1 when done. Advances 0x09e28f70.

Target-choice slot of DNA Transplant: state 0 asks the Attribute (duel_core_request_declare_attribute_ex), state 1 stores it as the slot value, records it in the link and posts command 8. Returns 0 while working, 1 when done.
Resolve slot of Hourglass of Courage: when the link's card is still face-up in its slot, sets the slot value to turn + 1 (+2 on its controller's turn) with duel_core_post_set_slot_value. Returns 0.

Resolve slot of The Inexperienced Spy: state 0x80 shows hint 0xf4 and starts a hand selection, state 0x7f reveals the chosen opponent hand card (duel_core_post_reveal_card and duel_core_post_reveal_hand_card). Returns the next state or 0.
1 when the opponent's hand count (+0x534) is not 0. Pure.
Resolve slot of Ancient Telescope: opens card list 5 (the opponent's Deck top) with duel_core_open_card_list when that Deck is not empty and no list is open. Returns 0.
1 when the opponent's Deck count (+0x538) is not 0. Pure.
Condition slot of Appropriate: link event 0x1a (draw) by the other side while 0x09e2d1e8 is set (not a Draw Phase draw). Pure.
Condition slot of Forced Requisition: link event 0x1e by the card's own side. Pure.
Condition slot of Minor Goblin Official: the opponent's LP (+0x0) are below 3001. Pure.
Resolve slot of Time Seal and Fenrir: duel_core_post_set_player_flag(opponent, 0). Returns 0.
Resolve slot of The Eye of Truth: duel_core_post_set_hand_reveal(opponent) and UI message 0x3c. Returns 0.
1 when the active field spell id (0x09e2bbc8) is 0x10f4 or 0x150b. Pure.
1 when both players control fewer than 3 monsters (duel_core_count_monsters). Pure.

Condition slot of the Talisman cards and three others: 0 for link event 0x24, else 1 when the side controls the card the source requires (0x1760 and 0x1765: 0x173c; 0x198a: 0x18f9; 0x1988 and 0x0eaa: 0x18a7) by duel_core_count_named_cards_on_side. Pure.
Condition slot of Field Barrier: 1 when no other copy of the card is on its side (duel_core_count_named_cards_except). Pure.

L1 builder: adds the Deck, Graveyard and hand cards with the name that the source card names (per-card table: 0x0e92 -> 0x1cb0, 0x1610 -> 0x1377 ...) through duel_effects_candidate_has_name with filter 0x802.
L1 builder: Deck cards of archetype 0x1f (duel_effects_candidate_in_archetype, filter 2).
L1 builder: Graveyard cards with the Attribute of the source card (filter attribute << 24 | 2).
L1 builder: Graveyard cards with the Type of the source card (filter race << 27 | 2).
L1 builder: Graveyard Spell Cards (zone 0xe); returns the count, or writes zone 4 to 0x09e29924 when a probe pointer is set.
L1 builder: Spell and Trap Cards among the top five cards of the opponent's Deck (zone 0xd); returns the count.
L4 End Phase handler: queues the field trigger (kind 5) of the first active copy of the card, own side first, and sets slot flag 0x1b; returns 1 when no copy queued.

For the first monster on either side carrying effect key: removes that marker, clears slot flag 0xe, removes marker 0x1419 and the own marker of 0x1cfe, 0x1ad5 and 0x183b, and removes its links. Returns 0, or 1 when no monster carries the key.

The n-th Ritual Monster that the Ritual Spell can Summon from the ritual table 0x09dec4d4 (any for 0x1b54; EARTH for 0x1716; DARK for 0x1698; else the table entry), or -1. Pure. Called by AI functions.

Summon-mask helper: 1 when a Tribute Summon of the monster is possible with Ancient Gear Castle's counters (0x19b2; one fewer while 0x1e03 is active), with Tributes allowed, a free zone, and a Zombie (race 2) while Zombie World (0x1eb1) is active.
Side the target prompt opens on (0x09e2d274 or the other one): equip spells that target enemy monsters (0x1842 0x149d 0x13f3 0x130e 0x130d) flip it; a list of cards keeps it. Pure.

column2: int duel_core_filter_gear_castle_tribute(uint side, int a, int b)
column3: Tribute filter of duel_core_summon_step_gear_castle_tribute: 0x800 for Ancient Gear Castle with enough counters for the monster's Level, else 0. Pure.

column2: void duel_core_count_links_of_slot_card(uint side, int slot, int a, int b)
column3: duel_core_count_links with the slot's card id (+0x3e) as the link source.

column2: void duel_core_mark_face_up_copies(int side, int card, int value)
column3: Sets slot value b to value on every face-up copy of the card in its zone (monster zones, Spell/Trap zones or the Field Zone by icon). Callers: draw, gain LP, damage and send functions.

Resolve slot of Magical Hats (state machine on 0x09e28f60): choose a monster you control, pick two Spell/Trap Cards from the Deck (card list 8), Special Summon them as monsters (duel_core_special_summon_impl), set the three face-down (face-up with a position change instead while Light of Intervention 0x135d is active), shuffle them (duel_core_shuffle_face_down_defense_monsters) and raise timing events 8/9/0xb for the moved monsters; then shuffle the Deck. Returns the next state or 0.

duel_core_summon_prepare step: when the summon is face-up (or Light of Intervention 0x135d is active) and duel_core_count_tribute_value gives 3 or more, builds an M1 link for the summoned card (0x09e290c0) and asks yes/no (message 0x123) when duel_effects_can_activate accepts it. Clears 0x09e2d248 and 0x09e290c6; sets the sub-step 0x09e290f2 to 1. Callers: duel_core_summon_prepare, duel_core_summon_step_swift_gaia.

column2: void duel_core_queue_sent_to_graveyard_triggers(int reason, uint flags, ushort *entry, uint move_flags, int source_card)
column3: Per-card hooks for a card sent to the Graveyard (destination zone 0xe) from the Deck or a list: queues the card's own trigger (duel_core_chain_queue_trigger, kind bits 0x40) when its per-card condition holds, posts player markers (Makyura 0x14a5 after command 0x2d, Destiny Hero - Double Dude, Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys, Vampire Lord, Dark Necrofear, Manticore of Darkness), and runs rules of other active cards (Pandemonium, Centrifugal Field, Miracle Jurassic Egg, Realm of Light / Lightsworn, Winged Kuriboh -> Sabatier). Callers: duel_core_send_deck_ref_to_graveyard_ex, duel_core_send_list_card_to_graveyard.

Queues the triggers that respond to the summon in the record 0x09e290bc and raises timing event `event` (6 Normal Summon, 7 Flip Summon, 8 Special Summon, 9 Set): Tribute-triggered monsters, Ancient Gear Castle counters (duel_core_add_counters type 1 on each Normal Summon or Set), Worm Gurus markers on a Flip Summon, per-card triggers in the field, hand and Graveyard and markers on the summoned monster. Callers: duel_core_summon_step_normal, _flip, _special, 0x09db19e0.

column2: void duel_core_post_announce_location_card(int side, uint location, uint instance)
column3: Posts command 0x2d (location, card id of the instance, instance): shows the card being announced. Callers: duel_core_send_hand_card (Makyura), duel_core_send_field_card_body, duel_core_send_battle_destroyed_cards, duel_core_battle_step_after_damage_calc, duel_core_summon_step_necroshade.

duel_core_find_slot_marker visitor of duel_effects_resolve_life_absorbing_machine: for a marker 0x14c0 of stage 0 gains half (rounded up) of its recorded LP payment with duel_core_gain_lp. Returns 0 (continue).

L4 End Phase handler (Thousand Energy, Triangle Power): when a player marker of the card exists on either side, destroys every monster of duel_effects_get_target_filter_mask for a link of the card (the record's slot +08 filter) with duel_core_request_destroy_mask_by_card and removes the marker. Returns 0 when it acted, 1 otherwise.
